info.title: Crow HR API
info.description: Versioned REST API used by the Crow HR web app and native apps. Within v1, changes are additive only; see docs/api.md.

get.description: The only cookie-authenticated GET with side effects; protected by `state`. Validates the ID token (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce) and the provider restrictions, links or matches the identity, then signs in.

302.description: Redirect into the app, or back to the sign-in page with an error.

get.summary: Relying-party public keys for a provider (Singpass)
Start single sign-on with a provider
get.description: Redirects to the identity provider (authorization code + PKCE S256, state and nonce kept server-side for 10 minutes). `purpose=test` is an owner's test sign-in; `purpose=link` links the provider to the signed-in user.

post.summary: Set a new password from a reset link
post.description: Single use. Revokes every session and device of the user.

post.description: Password sessions: password, plus a TOTP or recovery code when MFA is enrolled. SSO sessions re-authenticate by an SSO round-trip instead.

401.description: Error: invalid_credentials, invalid_mfa_code, session_expired, session_revoked, unauthenticated.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Every failure (unknown email, wrong password, suspended, locked) answers the same 401 invalid_credentials. When MFA is enrolled the response carries a pending-sign-in token instead of a session.

Owner only. The member enrols again at next sign-in (subject to the MFA policy).

post.description: For installs without email. Shown once; valid 60 minutes. hr_admins can do this only for members without assigned roles.

put.description: Owner only. Takes effect on the member's next request. The last active owner cannot lose the owner role.
